instruction: Open the Reminders app and mark the reminder titled "Review PR #128" as completed.
reference_command:
reminder_id=$(remindctl all --json | jq -r '.[] | select(.title == "Review PR #128") | .id' | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$reminder_id" ]; then
  echo "Reminder not found: Review PR #128"
  exit 1
fi
remindctl complete "$reminder_id"
